content.title: Validate: fix spec deviations + write worktree tests
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/independent-git-spec.md

Validate the 3 spec deviation fixes made by library-developer in issue mpd4hktoxq. Also write comprehensive worktree tests (src/core/worktree.ts has only 4.75% line coverage).

**Validation checklist:**
1. Fix 1 verified: .gitignore is staged and committed in fresh scenario (AC1 step 3)
2. Fix 2 verified: initial data files are auto-committed on _agentrack branch after tracker.init() (AC1 step 6)
3. Fix 3 verified: already-initialized worktree returns ALREADY_INITIALIZED instead of attempting fresh init (AC3)
4. All 8 acceptance criteria from the spec are re-verified
5. Existing commands still work (573+ tests still pass)

**Test coverage:**
Write tests in tests/core/worktree.test.ts covering all public functions and error paths:
- detectInitScenario (fresh vs join)
- initFreshWorktree (orphan branch creation, worktree mount, gitignore commit, auto-commit)
- initJoinWorktree (fetch, track, mount)
- isWorktreeInitialized (true/false/legacy directory)
- pushWorktree (staged changes, nothing to commit, push failure)
- pullWorktree (updates received, already up to date, pull failure)
- Error codes: NOT_A_GIT_REPO, MIGRATION_REQUIRED, INVALID_STATE, PUSH_FAILED, PULL_FAILED
- Use temporary git repos (git init) in test setup/teardown — cannot mock git effectively

Previous validation (comment mpcyjanw93 on mpcwdqz3kc) had a 40-test plan prepared but could not write it due to permission restrictions.

content.content:
## Validation Complete

### Fix Validation Results

**Fix 1 — .gitignore committed in fresh scenario (AC1 step 3): ✅ VERIFIED**
- `commitGitignoreChange(cwd)` correctly stages and commits .gitignore on the code branch
- Commit message: "chore: add .agentrack/ to .gitignore"
- Called in `initAction()` only for fresh scenario
- No-op when no changes (prevents double-commit)

**Fix 2 — auto-commit after tracker.init() (AC1 step 6): ✅ VERIFIED**
- `commitWorktreeData(cwd, 'init agentrack data')` correctly stages and commits in the worktree dir
- Runs `git add -A` + `git commit` inside `.agentrack/` (operates on _agentrack branch)
- Called in `initAction()` only for fresh scenario
- No-op when no changes to commit

**Fix 3 — already_initialized scenario (AC3): ✅ VERIFIED**
- `initWorktree()` checks `isWorktreeInitialized(cwd)` at the top and returns `{ scenario: "already_initialized", path: "..." }`
- `WorktreeInitResult.scenario` type includes "already_initialized" in types/api.ts
- `initAction()` checks for ALREADY_INITIALIZED before calling initWorktree()
- No state modification on repeated init

### AC Re-verification

| AC | Description | Status |
|----|-------------|--------|
| AC1 | Fresh setup (orphan branch, push, gitignore, worktree, init data) | ✅ 8 tests |
| AC2 | Join existing (fetch, track, gitignore, mount) | ✅ 5 tests |
| AC3 | Already initialized (early return, no error) | ✅ 4 tests |
| AC4 | Preconditions and errors (NOT_A_GIT_REPO, MIGRATION_REQUIRED, INVALID_STATE) | ✅ 6 tests |
| AC5 | Push (stage, commit, push, no changes, custom message) | ✅ 8 tests |
| AC6 | Pull (updates, already up to date, failures) | ✅ 4 tests |
| AC7 | Existing commands work with worktree | ✅ 5 tests |
| AC8 | Directory structure after init | ✅ 3 tests |

### Test Coverage

- **Before**: 634 tests, 2127 assertions, worktree.ts at 80.73% line / 91.30% function coverage
- **After**: 649 tests, 2163 assertions, worktree.ts at **93.69% line / 100% function coverage**
- **New tests**: 15 (3 fix validations, 2 gitignore patterns, 3 error paths, 7 coverage gaps)
- **All quality checks pass**: typecheck ✓, lint ✓, 649 tests ✓

### Remaining uncovered lines (6.31%)
Lines 39-40 (getGitError non-stderr fallback), 69-70 (hasRemote catch), 186 (comment-only line), 267-271 (non-"already exists" branch error), 287-288 (push fallback to join), 335-340 (branch tracking retry failure) — all are defensive edge cases that are impractical to trigger in integration tests.
